note: Pins are the SHAs the reference corpus was last validated against. Advance only via tools/sync-external.mjs --advance.

vta-browser-plugin.why: #275: a QR button beside every DID the extension draws (a bare DID, "Scan with Keyring"), for the first real phone scan of an upstream DID QR; carries #272 (the consent-window race, VTI-40), superseding our local fix

verifiable-trust-infrastructure.why: Match the Farm, which runs vta-service 0.42.0 and vtc-service 0.11.58: tag vta-service-v0.42.0 carries both. The local lab moves to it so lab runs test what the Farm runs.

affinidi-tdk-rs.why: Match the Farm's mediator, 0.29.4 (tag affinidi-messaging-mediator-v0.29.4); the local lab builds its mediator from this repo and was at 0.28.11.

openvtc.why: The openvtc build the interop harness gates on: both phases are green against it on the lab at the Farm's versions (2026-09-25). 177a218, the build this clone sat on by hand, cannot create a persona against VTA 0.42.0 (its vta-sdk 0.42.1 does not read contexts/get's 422 as NotFound; openvtc-core config/community_context.rs ~:296-303), so it cannot run either phase.

dtgwg-trust-tasks-tf.why: Specifications for vtc/join-requests/withdraw/0.1 and supplement/0.1, which the client now implements (VTI-03 client half).

dtgwg-cred-spec.why: Seeded for the locality plan: the VWC schema half (witnessContext, taskContext, digest) could not be verified locally. HEAD at #14 — digest REQUIRED; #18 (taskDigestMultibase on the credential) still open.

@openvtc/vti-tsp-js.tripwire: our noble HPKE is the shipped wire layer; any bump = crypto or CESR change — audit before adopting

@openvtc/pnm-core.tripwire: channel chain + consent surface; minor bump = wallet-facing API moved

@openvtc/trust-tasks.tripwire: the Cypress lock; any bump past 0.9.x = post-Cypress framework movement
